tools.name: publish_sponsored_post_with_charge
tools.description: Runs the static site build for a sponsored post and charges the sponsor's saved card for the placement fee. Use it when a paid sponsored article is ready to go live.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the sponsor

params.name: site_dir
params.description: Path to the site project directory

tools.code:
import subprocess
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"


@function_tool
def publish_sponsored_post_with_charge(post_id: int, customer_id: str, fee_cents: int, site_dir: str = ".") -> str:
    if fee_cents <= 0:
        return "error: fee must be positive"
    r = subprocess.run(
        ["hugo", "--minify", "--source", site_dir],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    if r.returncode != 0:
        return "build failed: " + r.stderr[-500:]
    cust = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    pm = cust.get("invoice_settings", {}).get("default_payment_method")
    if not pm:
        return "error: no default payment method"
    pi = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=fee_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=pm,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"Sponsored post {post_id}",
        metadata={"post_id": str(post_id)},
    )
    return f"built site, charge {pi.id} status {pi.status}"

tools.name: archive_post_and_rebuild_index
tools.description: Moves a post's markdown file from the drafts folder into the archive folder, reading its front matter first, and runs the search index rebuild script. Returns the post title and the script output.

params.name: slug
params.description: Slug of the post file, without extension

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def archive_post_and_rebuild_index(slug: str, content_dir: str) -> str:
    root = Path(content_dir)
    src = root / "drafts" / f"{slug}.md"
    dst = root / "archive" / f"{slug}.md"
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(src, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        title = next((l[6:].strip() for l in f if l.startswith("title:")), slug)
    shutil.move(str(src), str(dst))
    out = subprocess.run(["python", "scripts/rebuild_index.py", content_dir], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return f"{title}: {out.stdout.strip()}"

tools.name: pay_guest_author_and_move_to_paid
tools.description: Sends a payout to a guest author for an accepted article and moves the article's record from the pending payments table to the paid payments table.

params.name: account_id
params.description: Stripe connected account ID of the author

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("cms")
stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"


@mcp.tool()
def pay_guest_author_and_move_to_paid(article_id: int, account_id: str, amount_cents: int) -> str:
    t = stripe.Transfer.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        destination=account_id,
        metadata={"article_id": str(article_id)},
    )
    db = sqlite3.connect("cms.db")
    db.execute("INSERT INTO paid_payments (article_id, account_id, amount_cents, transfer_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)", (article_id, account_id, amount_cents, t.id))
    db.execute("DELETE FROM pending_payments WHERE article_id = ?", (article_id,))
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    return f"transfer {t.id} created"

tools.name: move_old_drafts_to_trash
tools.description: Finds draft posts untouched for a given number of days, moves them into a trash folder, and permanently deletes anything already in the trash folder older than the same cutoff. Returns the names of the drafts moved.

params.name: days
params.description: Age in days to count as stale

tools.code:
import os
import shutil
import time
from contextlib import suppress
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("cms")


@mcp.tool()
def move_old_drafts_to_trash(drafts_dir: str, trash_dir: str, days: int) -> str:
    cutoff = time.time() - days * 86400
    trash = Path(trash_dir)
    trash.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    moved = []
    with os.scandir(trash) as it:
        for e in it:
            if e.is_file() and e.stat().st_mtime < cutoff:
                with suppress(OSError):
                    os.remove(e.path)
    with os.scandir(drafts_dir) as it:
        for e in list(it):
            if e.is_file() and e.stat().st_mtime < cutoff:
                shutil.move(e.path, str(trash / e.name))
                moved.append(e.name)
    return ", ".join(moved) or "none"
